name: My Barber Shop
tagline: Barber booking for Uzbekistan — clients book a chair, barbers run their schedule
role: Our own product — mobile app, website and API

scenes.title: One app, two sides
scenes.body: Clients book a chair; barbers get their own workspace. The role is chosen at sign-in.

scenes.title: Find a barber nearby
scenes.body: The next visit is pinned on top; barbers are listed with rating, distance and starting price.

scenes.title: Pick a service, day and time
scenes.body: Open slots are computed from service length and the barber's bookings; payment happens at the shop.

scenes.title: A workspace for barbers
scenes.body: A day timeline plus incoming requests to accept or decline; the client is notified either way.

scenes.title: Earnings, month by month
scenes.body: Monthly total, a daily breakdown and recent jobs, with completed and cancelled counts.

scenes.title: Public site on Next.js 16
scenes.body: Landing, privacy and terms pages, in the same pnpm + Turborepo monorepo as the app and API.
